title: Who Vs Whom
theory:
 Both "who" and "whom" are Relative Pronouns used to connect a relative clause to a
       noun or pronoun representing a person.

      Who (Subject)                                      Whom (Object)
      Person                          Subject             Person                              Object

                           who                                                 whom

     Antecedent         Relative Pronoun                 Antecedent          Relative Pronoun

     Points to Remember
     Who is used as Subject.
     Whom is used as Object.
     Who and whom are used when antecedent is a person.

     Trick
